headline: gr1 (24 shared-primitive tasks): v4 latent has the strongest task semantic geometry. Leak-free cross-episode P@10 (base rate ~0.042): v4 0.273 > v3 0.251 > raw~=pca 0.228. KMeans ARI: v4 0.127 > v3 0.101 > raw 0.085 ~= pca 0.079; NMI: v4 0.384 > v3 0.335 > raw 0.328. Naive P@1 (v4 0.995) is inflated by same-episode temporal adjacency -> report cross-ep. dexjoco control (disjoint actions): all reps P@k ceiling; KMeans ARI v3 0.595 > v4 0.413 > raw 0.389 (action~=task so a clean action code separates best - matches prior vsep finding).

caveats.cross_episode: cross-episode P@k excludes same-episode neighbors (temporal adjacency confound). For dexjoco (1 val episode/task) there are NO cross-episode same-task pairs, so cross-ep P@k is degenerate (0.0) and should be reported N/A.
caveats.pca_kmeans: pca rep = top-256 PCA of z-scored raw, used as-is (preserves L2 for NN, so P@k~=raw). KMeans on PCA scores is variance-weighted and can differ from z-scored raw (e.g. dexjoco pca ARI 0.015 vs raw 0.389); NN metrics are the more comparable PCA baseline.
